programme.title: One Hundred Great Paintings
programme.desc: This was the last of many hauntingly beautiful sketches and paintings Constable made of Salisbury Cathedral. He worked on it for years. 'At last,' he wrote, 'I have got the Great Salisbury into the condition I wish to see it.'
